title: Emergent de Sitter Space and Non-Unitary Tensor Networks from Non-Hermitian Quantum Criticality
abstract: Non-unitary cMERA on a non-Hermitian critical chain; an emergent de Sitter bulk arises from boundary entanglement, with geodesics identified as RT surfaces and a timelike-to-null geodesic transition. An AdS->dS, non-unitary analog of the unitary MERA-holography construction.
key_claims: de Sitter bulk geometry emerges from a non-unitary cMERA on a non-Hermitian critical chain.
Bulk geodesics = RT surfaces; timelike-to-null geodesic transition present.
Provides an ER->geometry / RT extraction recipe adaptable to test whether the c=7/10 TCI network reproduces bulk geodesic structure.
